finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base and uniform advantage is excluded under both interval methods. Useful pooled and donor advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed writer/prompt resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor useful advantage is likewise excluded under writer resampling and unresolved under crossed resampling; residual pooled remains unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival residual intervals including zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods; its writer interval resolves worse performance, while its crossed interval includes zero. Raw base and pooled useful advantages are excluded under both methods; raw donor remains unresolved under both, with all model-rival raw intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Sparse histories, overlapping human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
